He provides operational support to Global Gateway and Economic Investment Plans. Subject: Follow-up: Energy/Heating Needs Project in Ukraine
 
Dear Ambassador Quesada, Dear Patricio,


Following up on our conversation, I wanted to provide an update regarding the potential project to address energy/heating needs in Ukraine.


As requested, we've gathered updated information on the district heating sector's priorities and critical needs, as identified by WASH partners. Attached, you'll find overviews of the district heating needs in:
Izium, Kharkiv oblast
Balakliya, Kharkiv oblast
Chernihiv
Shostka
Poltava
We also have information from authorities in the Vinnytsia region, primarily covering modular boiler houses, which we can provide if that location is preferred.


Based on this information, we would like to discuss your preferred location for the project. We suggest focusing on the procurement of:
Cogeneration units
Modular boiler houses
Pumps, pipes, valves, and other supportive materials
To give you an idea of costs, a 250-260 kW cogeneration unit is estimated at around USD 350,000, while a 5 MW modular boiler house is around USD 800,000-850,000. Supportive materials would be lower in cost.


With your prioritization, we can design a procurement project with an estimated duration of 11 months. Of course, we will coordinate with other partners to avoid duplication.


If this approach is acceptable, we will prepare a detailed concept note/project proposal. For you reference, we have also made initial high-level budget estimations for a project under USD 2 million:


Engagement Budget Categories	Total in USD
Activities/Procurement	$1,400,000
Personnel	$302,193
Non-personnel	$145,193
UNOPS Fee	$144,224
TOTAL	$1,991,611


Please let us know your thoughts and we'd be happy to discuss this in more detail on a call.


With thanks and kind regards


Elene

Let me share with you some background materials about UNOPS procurement rules and our partnership with the EU.


We appreciate your interest in strengthening the water and energy systems and we will revert soon with some options.


We look very much forward to working with you and please don't hesitate to reach out if you have any questions on UNOPS operations in Ukraine or in general.


Kind regards,
